notes: 161-page arXiv PDF (2606.12429). Seed also linked Muse Glimmer 30B, but that model is not discussed in this report, so covers is only meta/muse-spark. Primary scorecards are Tables 1–2 (Thinking configuration; refusal rows marked ∗ are on the deployed Meta AI system). Many figure-only charts (StrongREJECT cascaded stages, BioDesign per-task bars, GDM-Stealth per-challenge bars, FORTRESS bar chart without Muse Spark numeric label in text) were skipped or partially covered via table/text numbers. Content safety §5 states Meta AI met launch thresholds but withholds quantitative violation rates. Alignment Faking Claude value uses Unicode minus (−2.8) as printed. Qwen3 and OSS Models A/B/C kept as rawModelName. Cap prioritized safety/alignment plus key capability tables; not every appendix or per-attack BioTIER cell was transcribed.
